opening: I've had high fevers every day.
The fevers, night sweats, weight loss, poor appetite and weakness have been going on for a month.
I feel weak and drained all over.
I used to drink heavily, but that was a long time ago.

opening.text: I've had high fevers every day, along with night sweats, and I've lost my appetite. I feel weak and drained all over, and I've lost 20 kg. Recently I've turned yellow. These symptoms have been going on for a month. I used to drink heavily, but that was a long time ago.
